svg.title: Full network: conv layers, inner dense layer, output dense layer
svg.desc: The image is turned into a vector representation by the convolutional layers. An inner dense layer converts this vector into an inner representation, and the output dense layer converts that into 10 values, one per class: dress, hat, longsleeve, outwear, pants, shirt, shoes, shorts, skirt and t-shirt. The highest value, t-shirt, is the prediction.
